evidence: Modifies `src/index/txindex.cpp`, `src/index/txindex.h`, and `src/index/tx_lookup_result.h` to decouple txindex lookups from full block storage on disk.
rationale: Enables running `-txindex` concurrently with `-prune`, resolving four long-standing feature requests dating back to 2017 (#10609, #12651, #16182, and #35240). Pruned node operators can now maintain full transaction index metadata without storing the entire blockchain history on disk.
